steps.name: Pick your first relic.
Pick up a Slayer task from Jacquelyn.

steps.notes: The [[Musician_(Lumbridge)|musician]] is north of Lumbridge lodestone.

[[Caitlin's Staff]] gives unlimited air runes and allows you to use magic for combat until you arrive in Varrock later. If you need more gp, you can sell the six [[Demon statuette (disambiguation)|demon statuettes]] in the catacombs to Xenia for 2,500 gp total.
Get at least level 2 Thieving and about 2,000 gp.
Vegetable stall: Eat the cabbage and onion using the bank chest to unnote the items if you have Golden Touch.
Keep going until level 10+. Hold on to the magic combat items, bank everything else.

steps.name: Buy supplies from the fishing store.
steps.notes: [[Lumbridge Fishing Supplies]] is on the west side of the market. You'll need about 50 bait and 50 feathers for a total of ~500 gp.
West of the fishing shop. Bury the bones. Focus on Magic and Defence xp.
Tree patch southwest of Lumbridge Market. Drop the weeds.
Fletch a wood box to store excess logs before moving to the swamp. Turn off Endless Harvest banking temporarily if you have it.
It takes 10 basic trees to reach level 10 Woodcutting.
No need to finish this task now, just get 10 Fletching here. You'll be Woodcutting on Havenhythe later. It takes ~47 basic trees to get 10 Fletching. Keep 5 extra logs for burning soon.
Kill a few until you have buried 10 bones. Cook at least one rat meat.
Switch back to net fishing at level 15.
Use up your remaining 4 logs to cook the Shrimp.
Drop the food and burnt food.
At this point your inventory should be: Wood Box, Feathers, Arrow Shafts, and at least 21 empty spaces.
Hold on to 1 clay to turn into Soft Clay.

steps.name: Home teleport to Wendlewick.
steps.notes: Keyboard shortcut: Alt+W
The furnace is on the east side of Wendlewick.
Make 50x Bronze bolts (unf) and 1x Bronze ore box. Deposit the rest of the bars in the metal bank.
Equip the bronze bolts to save inventory space.
Continue east toward [[Marigold Farm]] (south from the bridge) and use the well. Drop the soft clay.
There are potatoes outside the farmhouse to pick and a range inside to cook on.
Collect 2 wheat north of the farm. One for bread, another for Cook's Assistant.
A pot spawns on the bottom floor of the windmill on a table. Collect 2 to turn both wheat into flour.
Make sure to only make 1 wheat into bread dough.

steps.name: Collect an egg.
steps.notes: Used for Cook's Assistant.
There's a bucket on the ground in the trough room. Keep the milk for Cook's Assistant.
A sink and range is in the farmhouse at Marigold Farm.
He wanders all around the island, so keep an eye out for him.
Continue east toward [[Eastfold Farm]] where the sheep are. There is a spinning wheel in the house. You can drop the bowstring.
Collect 14 balls of wool total. There is 1 that spawns on the table in the farm.
Keyboard shortcut: L

steps.name: Pickpocket from the Farmers around Marigold Farm.
steps.notes: Get to level 15 Thieving. It should only take about 30 seconds. You can drop the seeds for now, but keep an eye out for Marigold and Guam seeds.

steps.name: Complete the Cook's Assistant quest.
steps.notes: Complete [[Cook's Assistant]]
You may not see one, but keep an eye out as you're walking around Misthalin.
The entrance to the hideout is south of the duck pond.

steps.name: Pick your second relic.
steps.notes: If you don't have enough points yet, you'll have it soon.

steps.name: Unlock the Draynor lodestone.
Begin the quest Vampyre Slayer.
steps.notes: You're not completing [[Vampyre Slayer]] right here, just picking it up before going to Varrock.

steps.name: Kill goblins for level 20 Magic and Defence.
steps.notes: The goblins are south of [[Eastfold Farm]], close to the coast. It should take about 15-20 goblins to get to level 20.
Complete the slayer task if you haven't already.

steps.name: With Golden Touch, continue until you have ~60k gp.
steps.notes: Without Golden Touch, you just need ~2,000 gp.
The wisp colony is southeast of Draynor, on the way to the Wizards' Tower.
Staying here until 20 Divination opens up Bright Wisps near the Archaeology Campus later.
If this is too crowded, you can skip it for now.
Two islands north of the start location. 14 Runecrafting.

steps.name: Home teleport to Lumbridge.
steps.notes: Start heading toward Varrock.
Collect one set of bones.

steps.name: Continue Vampyre Slayer at Blue Moon Inn.
steps.notes: Buy an extra beer for [[Bill]] later.
Bought at [[Horvik's Armor Shop]] near Varrock market. Skip this step without Golden Touch.
Bought at [[Horvik's Armor Shop]] near Varrock market. Skip this step without Golden Touch.
Bought at [[Zaff's Superior Spellcasting]]. Skip this step without Golden Touch.
Bought at [[Zaff's Superior Spellcasting]]. Skip this step without Golden Touch.

steps.name: Buy a wand, magic shield/orb, and some elemental runes while you're in Varrock.
steps.notes: Use a shield if you took [[Teragard's Aegis]]. You can sell or bank any gear you're not using.

steps.name: Start the quest New Foundations at King Roald.
steps.notes: [[New Foundations]]

steps.name: Unlock the Karamja region.
steps.notes: [[Equilibrium_League/Regions/Karamja|Karamja]]
Just outside the south entrance.

steps.name: Complete the Natural History Quiz in Varrock Museum.
steps.notes: There are no good training methods for Hunter, so the [[Natural History Quiz]] will get you to 25 Hunter.
The next available Divination energy is at level 50, so don't bother going past the minimum here.
Keep the [[Archaeology journal]] in your pocket slot. Take the opportunity to bank any unneeded items (Vampyre Slayer will not be completed for a while).

steps.name: Progress through New Foundations up to the point where the Workshop is built.
steps.notes: Head north from the [[Archaeology Campus]] to [[Fort Forinthry]]. You can buy materials from [[Bill]] or gather them yourself. You may not have enough gold without Golden Touch. Regular [[Logs]] can be gathered from the nearby [[Tree|trees]]. [[Limestone]] can be gathered from the [[Silvarea quarry]] near [[Paterdomus]]. There is a deposit box south of Silvarea near the mansion.
Feel free to skip this step without the funds to buy materials. Gathering takes a while.

steps.name: Build the Fort Forinthry lodestone.
steps.notes: Skip this step if New Foundations isn't completed.

steps.name: Home teleport to Wendlewick.
steps.notes: The bank is north of the lodestone. Get your wood box, combat runes (Air), Marigold and Guam seeds, and bank everything else.
It's south of the lodestone. You can teleport or run.

steps.name: Buy a hunter supplies from the Groundskeeper.
steps.notes: The [[Groundskeeper]] has a [[The Birds and the Bees|shop]] south of the lighthouse. You need at least 1 [[Clockwork]], but multiple are fine. You can also pick up some [[Rabbit snare|Rabbit snares]] here after getting 32 Hunter.
1 Clockwork + 1 Logs. You get the Clockwork back when checking the birdhouse.

steps.name: Head east to Marigold Farm.
steps.notes: You will be Farming, but fill your time with checking Birdhouses, Woodcutting, Fletching, and Thieving while waiting for plants to grow. There are [[Farmer|farmers]] and [[Master Farmer|master farmers]] in the area to collect seeds from.
Keep at least 1 unnoted [[Marigold]] from farming.
There are several [[birdhouse]] hotspots around the area. Basic birdhouses take 30 seconds and use 1 seed as bait.
Continue Woodcutting and Fletching while waiting for crops to grow. The goal is 35 Woodcutting. Finish the arrow shaft task from earlier if it isn't complete already.
You can upgrade your [[wood box]] as you level fletching.
Pickpocketing will be your primary way to gather seeds. Your goal is to get 40-50 Thieving here.
The most important task. South of Eastfold Farm, near the pond with ducks. There is a [[Anya|red tent]] there.

If you didn't find one while woodcutting or thieving, don't worry about it. Pick up the [[butterfly net]] off the ground here. If none are available, you can buy one from the shop in [[Hollow Hill]], in the cave near [[Ivar, King of Bones|Ivar]] to the east.
This is auto-completed on unlocking Karamja, so enjoy the free 30 points.
These are on the cliffs around Raz's house. You shouldn't need to for this task, but you can only catch [[Gold spirit moth|gold spirit moths]] with a [[butterfly net]] for now.
Far to the north and west of the cliffs here, overhanging the ocean.
These are quite good money with Golden Touch, so stay here until 50 Thieving if you didn't get it earlier.
This red vine grows on many of the houses in Wendlewick.
West beach of Havenhythe.

steps.name: Home teleport to Lumbridge.
steps.notes: You can buy upgraded hatchets from [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] or smith one (coming up next) while you're here.

steps.name: Home teleport to Varrock.
steps.notes: You can bank, stock up on runes, and finish up any tasks that required gold earlier if you have enough now.
Switch to bait fishing at level 10.

The ore can be gathered from the [[Highweald Ruins mine]], a cave near where the hollow trees were. The silver can't be stored in the ore box, but grab some extra copper and tin to level your smithing.
Use the lodestone to get back more quickly. You can smelt and smith this at the furnace in Wendlewick.

steps.name: Bank your items and grab your ore box.

steps.notes: Take the opportunity to level mining and smithing to 30 here and upgrade your hatchet and pickaxe using the furnace and anvil in Lumbridge.
If you took [[Divine Druid]] and have any [[Sign of the Porter|porters]], you can use those here to automatically bank the essence.
Head directly north of Draynor lodestone to start this quest.

steps.name: Unlock the Um lodestone.
Travel to the Sanctum of Rebirth.
steps.notes: Use the [[gondola]] on the docks north of [[Kharen]] to get there.

steps.name: Get 20 Divination at Gate of Elidinis.
steps.notes: Start the encounter at Icthlarin. Gather 10 Moonstone and repair the [[Moonstone conduit]]. Transmute the [[Corrupt shard of Elidinis|red shards]] behind the barrier (around Icthlarin) until you hit 20 Divination. It should  take about 7 shards. Don't worry about mechanics, just go again if you die.

steps.name: Home teleport to Draynor.
Claim a Dramen Staff from the League Sage.
steps.notes: The [[Sage]] is in Lumbridge Castle's courtyard.

steps.name: Pick your third relic.
Optional: Complete the Stronghold of Security.
steps.notes: There are no Easy or Medium tasks for this, so only complete this if you're low on gold.

If you didn't take [[Golden Touch]], you can use one of the lamps on Agility to get at least level 12 which you need for an upcoming task. Archaeology, Runecrafting, and Crafting are other good choices.
Travel through the [[Zanaris shed|shed]] with your [[Dramen staff]] and head right back to finish mining.
Use the [[Fairy ring#DKR|fairy ring east of Edgeville]]. You will be using code [[Fairy ring#DLP|DLP]] to get to [[Amberfell]]. Bring some food along with you.

steps.name: Steal some food from the Bakery Stall.
steps.notes: You want to get about 20-30 [[Cake]] from the [[Bakery Stall]] in [[Lumbridge Market]].

steps.name: Use the Fairy Ring to travel to Inanna's Shrine.
steps.notes: The Fairy ring code is [[Fairy ring#BKS|BKS]].
Head east and north and use the cave entrance under the [[Sanguine crawler|Sanguine crawlers]].
Continue north to [[Hollow Hill]] and enter Ivar's arena.

steps.name: Home teleport to Karamja.

steps.notes: You can drop and pick up the same seaweed repeatedly.
South of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]].
Head back north to the lodestone or teleport there.
The [[Greater demon|Greater demons]] are south of the agility shortcut and up the first stairs you see.
Head back to Brimhaven via the [[Karamja lodestone]] or by running.
These are east of Brimhaven, toward [[Musa Point]].
Enter the [[Tzhaar City]] at the top of the volcano.
Exit the city and head east toward the [[Banana Plantation]].
